lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li4Mn8O16 (reduced formula LiMn2O4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2 (No. 38), with 28 atoms per unit cell distributed over 9 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Li centers in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Mn centers adopt octahedral coordination with varying O neighbor counts. The Li- and Mn-centered octahedra share edges, and Mn-centered octahedra additionally share corners and edges with one another. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 28 sites.
